Script.name: ishtar_cal_init
Script.script:
-- ishtar_cal - Kalendarz Ishtar dla Mudlet (port pluginu Dargoth, silnik okien) -- Zrodlo czasu: komenda "czas" (parsowana wlasnym kalendarzem). Brak zaleznosci od GMCP.
ishtar_cal = ishtar_cal or {}
do
local PLUGIN_VERSION = "1.8.20m" local PLUGIN_BUILD = "25-08-2026"
local REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE = 2 local GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY = 24 * 60 local REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S = 3.5 local MAX_EYSENLAAN_OCCURRENCES = 2
ishtar_cal.version = PLUGIN_VERSION ishtar_cal.build = PLUGIN_BUILD
-- UWAGA (1.8.12m): rok Ishtar zaczyna sie od 1 Saovine (konwencja gry, -- empirycznie potwierdzona). Przesuniecie punktu zerowego o 45 dni - -- wszystkie wyniki (odliczania, daty RL) pozostaja identyczne. local ISHTAR_SEASONS = { "Saovine", "Yule", "Imbaelk", "Birke", "Blathe", "Feainn", "Lammas", "Velen", } local DAYS_PER_SEASON = 45 local DAYS_PER_YEAR = #ISHTAR_SEASONS * DAYS_PER_SEASON -- 360 local YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES = DAYS_PER_YEAR * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY
local SEASON_INDEX = {} for i, s in ipairs(ISHTAR_SEASONS) do SEASON_INDEX[s:lower()] = i - 1 end
local SUNRISE_BY_SEASON_HOUR = { Yule = 8, Imbaelk = 7, Birke = 6, Blathe = 5, Feainn = 4, Lammas = 5, Velen = 7, Saovine = 6, } local SUNSET_BY_SEASON_HOUR = { Yule = 16, Imbaelk = 18, Birke = 19, Blathe = 21, Feainn = 20, Lammas = 20, Velen = 18, Saovine = 17, }
local HOLIDAY_WINDOW_GAME_MINUTES = 24 * 60 local BELLETEYN_DAY_OF_YEAR = 180 -- ostatni dzien Birke (numeracja od 1 Saovine) local EYSENLAAN_FAIR_START_DAY_OF_MONTH = 6 local EYSENLAAN_FAIR_DAYS = 3
-- okna przesuniete o +45 dni (numeracja od 1 Saovine); te same dni fizyczne local FULL_MOON_WINDOWS_RAW = { { 49, 51 }, { 73, 75 }, { 97, 99 }, { 121, 123 }, { 145, 147 }, { 169, 171 }, { 193, 195 }, { 217, 219 }, { 241, 243 }, { 267, 269 }, { 289, 291 }, { 313, 315 }, { 337, 339 }, { 1, 3 }, { 25, 27 }, }
local function trim(s) return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function pad2(n) return string.format("%02d", n) end
local function clampDayOfYear(d) if type(d) ~= "number" or d ~= d then return 1 end return math.max(1, math.min(DAYS_PER_YEAR, math.floor(d))) end
local function clampInt(n, minv, maxv) if type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n then return minv end return math.max(minv, math.min(maxv, math.floor(n))) end
local function isValidIshtarTime(dayOfYear, hours, minutes) if type(dayOfYear) ~= "number" or type(hours) ~= "number" or type(minutes) ~= "number" then return false end return dayOfYear >= 1 and dayOfYear <= DAYS_PER_YEAR and hours >= 0 and hours <= 23 and minutes >= 0 and minutes <= 59 end
local function clampIshtarTime(dayOfYear, hours, minutes) return { dayOfYear = math.max(1, math.min(DAYS_PER_YEAR, math.floor(dayOfYear))), hours = math.max(0, math.min(23, math.floor(hours))), minutes = math.max(0, math.min(59, math.floor(minutes))), } end
local function momentToGameMinutes(dayOfYear, hour, minute) local dayIndex = clampDayOfYear(dayOfYear) - 1 return dayIndex * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY + hour * 60 + minute end
local function seasonIndexOf(season) local idx = SEASON_INDEX[tostring(season):lower()] return idx ~= nil and idx or -1 end
local function seasonOfDayOfYear(dayOfYear) local d = clampDayOfYear(dayOfYear) local idx = math.floor((d - 1) / DAYS_PER_SEASON) idx = math.max(0, math.min(#ISHTAR_SEASONS - 1, idx)) return ISHTAR_SEASONS[idx + 1] end
local function duskHourForDayOfYear(dayOfYear) return SUNSET_BY_SEASON_HOUR[seasonOfDayOfYear(dayOfYear)] end
local function boundaryStartDayOfYearForSeason(season) local idx = seasonIndexOf(season) if idx < 0 then return 1 end local prevIdx = (idx - 1 + #ISHTAR_SEASONS) % #ISHTAR_SEASONS return prevIdx * DAYS_PER_SEASON + DAYS_PER_SEASON end
-- Pelnia ksiezyca: stale dane empiryczne (start 00:00 dnia startDay, koniec 00:00 dnia endDay). local FULL_MOON_STARTS = {} for _, w in ipairs(FULL_MOON_WINDOWS_RAW) do local startDay = clampDayOfYear(w[1]) local endDay = clampDayOfYear(w[2]) if endDay > startDay then FULL_MOON_STARTS[#FULL_MOON_STARTS + 1] = { startDay = startDay, startMinuteOfYear = momentToGameMinutes(startDay, 0, 0), windowMinutes = (endDay - startDay) * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY, } end end table.sort(FULL_MOON_STARTS, function(a, b) return a.startMinuteOfYear < b.startMinuteOfYear end)
local function buildHolidayEvents() local defs = {} local function addBoundary(id, name, kind, seasonStartsAtBoundary, emphasize) local startDayOfYear = boundaryStartDayOfYearForSeason(seasonStartsAtBoundary) defs[#defs + 1] = { id = id, name = name, kind = kind, startDayOfYear = startDayOfYear, startHour = duskHourForDayOfYear(startDayOfYear), startMinute = 0, emphasize = emphasize and true or false, windowGameMinutes = HOLIDAY_WINDOW_GAME_MINUTES, } end local function addFixed(id, name, kind, dayOfYear, emphasize, hour, minute, windowGM) local startDayOfYear = clampDayOfYear(dayOfYear) defs[#defs + 1] = { id = id, name = name, kind = kind, startDayOfYear = startDayOfYear, startHour = (type(hour) == "number") and hour or duskHourForDayOfYear(startDayOfYear), startMinute = (type(minute) == "number") and minute or 0, emphasize = emphasize and true or false, windowGameMinutes = (type(windowGM) == "number") and windowGM or HOLIDAY_WINDOW_GAME_MINUTES, } end
addBoundary("midinvaerne", "Midinvaerne", "astronomiczne", "Yule") addBoundary("birke", "Birke", "astronomiczne", "Birke") addBoundary("midaete", "Midaete", "astronomiczne", "Feainn") addBoundary("velen", "Velen", "astronomiczne", "Velen")
addBoundary("imbaelk", "Imbaelk", "magiczne", "Imbaelk") addFixed("belleteyn", "Belleteyn", "magiczne", BELLETEYN_DAY_OF_YEAR, true) addBoundary("lammas", "Lammas", "magiczne", "Lammas") addBoundary("saovine", "Saovine", "magiczne", "Saovine", true)
return defs end
local HOLIDAYS = buildHolidayEvents()
local function isWithinWindow(nowGM, startGM, windowGM, yearTotal) local endv = startGM + windowGM if endv <= yearTotal then return nowGM >= startGM and nowGM < endv end local endWrapped = endv - yearTotal return nowGM >= startGM or nowGM < endWrapped end
local function minutesUntilWindowEnd(nowGM, startGM, windowGM, yearTotal) if windowGM <= 0 then return 0 end local endv = startGM + windowGM if endv <= yearTotal then return math.max(0, endv - nowGM) end local endWrapped = endv - yearTotal if nowGM >= startGM then return yearTotal - nowGM + endWrapped end return math.max(0, endWrapped - nowGM) end
local function makeOccurrenceFromStart(def, nowGM, startGM, yearTotal) local activeNow = isWithinWindow(nowGM, startGM, def.windowGameMinutes, yearTotal) local deltaToStart = startGM - nowGM if deltaToStart < 0 then deltaToStart = deltaToStart + yearTotal end
if activeNow then local untilEnd = minutesUntilWindowEnd(nowGM, startGM, def.windowGameMinutes, yearTotal) return { id = def.id, name = def.name, kind = def.kind, emphasize = def.emphasize and true or false, deltaToStart = 0, activeNow = true, windowGameMinutes = def.windowGameMinutes, gameMinutesUntilEnd = untilEnd, } end
return { id = def.id, name = def.name, kind = def.kind, emphasize = def.emphasize and true or false, deltaToStart = deltaToStart, activeNow = false, windowGameMinutes = def.windowGameMinutes, gameMinutesUntilEnd = 0, } end
local function computeNextOccurrencesForFixed(def, nowGM, yearTotal) local startDayOfYear = clampDayOfYear(def.startDayOfYear) local startGM = momentToGameMinutes(startDayOfYear, def.startHour, def.startMinute) return makeOccurrenceFromStart(def, nowGM, startGM, yearTotal) end
local function computeFullMoonOccurrence(now) local nowGM = momentToGameMinutes(now.dayOfYear, now.hours, now.minutes) local function baseDef(startDay, windowMinutes) return { id = "pelnia", name = "Pelnia ksiezyca", kind = "ksiezycowe", startDayOfYear = startDay, startHour = 0, startMinute = 0, emphasize = true, windowGameMinutes = windowMinutes, } end
for _, w in ipairs(FULL_MOON_STARTS) do local occ = makeOccurrenceFromStart(baseDef(w.startDay, w.windowMinutes), nowGM, w.startMinuteOfYear, YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES) if occ.activeNow then return occ end end
local best = nil local bestDelta = math.huge for _, w in ipairs(FULL_MOON_STARTS) do local delta = w.startMinuteOfYear - nowGM if delta < 0 then delta = delta + YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES end if delta < bestDelta then bestDelta = delta; best = w end end
if not best then return computeNextOccurrencesForFixed(baseDef(1, 0), nowGM, YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES) end return makeOccurrenceFromStart(baseDef(best.startDay, best.windowMinutes), nowGM, best.startMinuteOfYear, YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES) end
local function computeNextEysenlaanFairs(now) local today = clampDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) local nowGM = momentToGameMinutes(today, now.hours, now.minutes)
local seasonIdx = math.floor((today - 1) / DAYS_PER_SEASON) local seasonDayOfMonth = ((today - 1) % DAYS_PER_SEASON) + 1 local currentSeasonStart = seasonIdx * DAYS_PER_SEASON + 1 local nextSeasonIdx = (seasonIdx + 1) % #ISHTAR_SEASONS local nextSeasonStart = nextSeasonIdx * DAYS_PER_SEASON + 1
local firstStartDayOfYear if seasonDayOfMonth <= EYSENLAAN_FAIR_START_DAY_OF_MONTH + EYSENLAAN_FAIR_DAYS - 1 then firstStartDayOfYear = currentSeasonStart + (EYSENLAAN_FAIR_START_DAY_OF_MONTH - 1) else firstStartDayOfYear = nextSeasonStart + (EYSENLAAN_FAIR_START_DAY_OF_MONTH - 1) end
local firstSeasonIdx = math.floor((clampDayOfYear(firstStartDayOfYear) - 1) / DAYS_PER_SEASON) local secondSeasonStart = ((firstSeasonIdx + 1) % #ISHTAR_SEASONS) * DAYS_PER_SEASON + 1 local secondStartDayOfYear = secondSeasonStart + (EYSENLAAN_FAIR_START_DAY_OF_MONTH - 1)
local windowGM = EYSENLAAN_FAIR_DAYS * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY local startsList = { clampDayOfYear(firstStartDayOfYear), clampDayOfYear(secondStartDayOfYear) } local occ = {} for _, day in ipairs(startsList) do local def = { id = "festyn_eysenlaan", name = "Festyn w Eysenlaan", kind = "lokalne", startDayOfYear = day, startHour = 0, startMinute = 0, emphasize = true, windowGameMinutes = windowGM, } local startGM = momentToGameMinutes(def.startDayOfYear, 0, 0) occ[#occ + 1] = makeOccurrenceFromStart(def, nowGM, startGM, YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES) end
table.sort(occ, function(a, b) return a.deltaToStart < b.deltaToStart end) local out = {} for i = 1, math.min(MAX_EYSENLAAN_OCCURRENCES, #occ) do out[i] = occ[i] end return out end
local function computeNextOccurrences(now) local nowGM = momentToGameMinutes(now.dayOfYear, now.hours, now.minutes) local all = {} for _, def in ipairs(HOLIDAYS) do all[#all + 1] = computeNextOccurrencesForFixed(def, nowGM, YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES) end all[#all + 1] = computeFullMoonOccurrence(now) for _, o in ipairs(computeNextEysenlaanFairs(now)) do all[#all + 1] = o end table.sort(all, function(a, b) return a.deltaToStart < b.deltaToStart end) return all end
local function mergeOccurrences(occ) local fixedMap = {} local fixedOrder = {} local multi = {}
for _, o in ipairs(occ) do local isMulti = (o.id == "festyn_eysenlaan") local item = { id = isMulti and (o.id .. "|" .. o.deltaToStart) or o.id, name = o.name, kind = o.kind, emphasize = o.emphasize and true or false, deltaToStart = o.deltaToStart, activeNow = o.activeNow, windowGameMinutes = o.windowGameMinutes, gameMinutesUntilEnd = o.gameMinutesUntilEnd, } if isMulti then multi[#multi + 1] = item else local existing = fixedMap[o.id] if not (existing and existing.deltaToStart <= o.deltaToStart) then if not fixedMap[o.id] then fixedOrder[#fixedOrder + 1] = o.id end fixedMap[o.id] = item end end end
local merged = {} for _, id in ipairs(fixedOrder) do merged[#merged + 1] = fixedMap[id] end for _, m in ipairs(multi) do merged[#merged + 1] = m end table.sort(merged, function(a, b) return a.deltaToStart < b.deltaToStart end) return merged end
-- ---------- Formatowanie czasu RL (delta ishtar = PADDED) ---------- local function addGameMinutes(baseSec, gm) return baseSec + gm * REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE end
local function formatRealDateTime(ts) local d = os.date("*t", ts) return string.format("%s-%s-%d %s:%s", pad2(d.day), pad2(d.month), d.year, pad2(d.hour), pad2(d.min)) end
local function formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(deltaGM) local totalMinutes = math.max(0, math.floor((deltaGM * REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE) / 60 + 0.5)) local days = math.floor(totalMinutes / (60 * 24)) local rest = totalMinutes - days * 60 * 24 local hrs = math.floor(rest / 60) local mins = rest % 60 return string.format("%dd %sh %sm", days, pad2(hrs), pad2(mins)) end
local function kindLabel(kind) if kind == "astronomiczne" then return "swieto astronomiczne" end if kind == "magiczne" then return "swieto magiczne" end if kind == "lokalne" then return "festyn" end return "wydarzenie ksiezycowe" end
local function cleanName(name) return (trim(name):gsub("%s+", " ")) end
local function formatEventLines(item, nowSec) local name = cleanName(item.name) local label = kindLabel(item.kind) local lines = {}
if item.emphasize then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" *** %s (%s) ***", name, label) else lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" %s (%s)", name, label) end
if item.activeNow then if item.windowGameMinutes > 0 then local realEnd = addGameMinutes(nowSec, item.gameMinutesUntilEnd) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" TRWA TERAZ (do %s)", formatRealDateTime(realEnd)) else lines[#lines + 1] = " TRWA TERAZ" end return lines end
local realStartSec = addGameMinutes(nowSec, item.deltaToStart) if item.windowGameMinutes > 0 and item.kind == "lokalne" then local realEnd = realStartSec + item.windowGameMinutes * REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Od: %s", formatRealDateTime(realStartSec)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Do: %s", formatRealDateTime(realEnd)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(item.deltaToStart)) else lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDateTime(realStartSec)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(item.deltaToStart)) end return lines end
local function formatMainMagicLines(item, nowSec) local name = cleanName(item.name) local lines = {}
if item.id == "belleteyn" then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" *** %s (dzien %d) ***", name, BELLETEYN_DAY_OF_YEAR) else lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" *** %s ***", name) end
if item.activeNow then if item.windowGameMinutes > 0 then local realEnd = addGameMinutes(nowSec, item.gameMinutesUntilEnd) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" TRWA TERAZ (do %s)", formatRealDateTime(realEnd)) else lines[#lines + 1] = " TRWA TERAZ" end return lines end
local realStartSec = addGameMinutes(nowSec, item.deltaToStart) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDateTime(realStartSec)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(item.deltaToStart)) return lines end
local function buildResultLines(now, nowSecOpt) local nowSec = nowSecOpt or os.time() local upcoming = mergeOccurrences(computeNextOccurrences(now))
local mainMagic = {} local other = {} for _, item in ipairs(upcoming) do if item.kind == "magiczne" and item.emphasize then mainMagic[#mainMagic + 1] = item else other[#other + 1] = item end end
local lines = {} lines[#lines + 1] = "Glowne swieta magiczne:" for _, item in ipairs(mainMagic) do for _, l in ipairs(formatMainMagicLines(item, nowSec)) do lines[#lines + 1] = l end end
lines[#lines + 1] = "" lines[#lines + 1] = "Inne najblizsze wydarzenia:" for _, ev in ipairs(other) do for _, l in ipairs(formatEventLines(ev, nowSec)) do lines[#lines + 1] = l end end
return lines end
-- ---------- Parsowanie odpowiedzi "czas" ---------- local UNITS = { pierwszy=1,pierwsza=1,pierwsze=1, drugi=2,druga=2,drugie=2, trzeci=3,trzecia=3,trzecie=3, czwarty=4,czwarta=4,czwarte=4, piaty=5,piata=5,piate=5, szosty=6,szosta=6,szoste=6, siodmy=7,siodma=7,siodme=7, osmy=8,osma=8,osme=8, dziewiaty=9,dziewiata=9,dziewiate=9, dziesiaty=10,dziesiata=10,dziesiate=10, jedenasty=11,jedenasta=11,jedenaste=11, dwunasty=12,dwunasta=12,dwunaste=12, trzynasty=13,trzynasta=13,trzynaste=13, czternasty=14,czternasta=14,czternaste=14, pietnasty=15,pietnasta=15,pietnaste=15, szesnasty=16,szesnasta=16,szesnaste=16, siedemnasty=17,siedemnasta=17,siedemnaste=17, osiemnasty=18,osiemnasta=18,osiemnaste=18, dziewietnasty=19,dziewietnasta=19,dziewietnaste=19, } local TENS = { dwudziesty=20,dwudziesta=20,dwudzieste=20, trzydziesty=30,trzydziesta=30,trzydzieste=30, czterdziesty=40,czterdziesta=40,czterdzieste=40, }
local function parsePolishOrdinalDay(words) local w = trim(words:lower()) if UNITS[w] then return UNITS[w] end if TENS[w] then return TENS[w] end local p1, p2 = w:match("^(%a+)[%s%-]+(%a+)$") if p1 and p2 then local t = TENS[p1]; local u = UNITS[p2] if type(t) == "number" and type(u) == "number" then return t + u end end return nil end
local HOUR_WORD_VALUE = { polnoc = 0, pierwsza = 1, druga = 2, trzecia = 3, czwarta = 4, piata = 5, szosta = 6, siodma = 7, osma = 8, dziewiata = 9, dziesiata = 10, jedenasta = 11, dwunasta = 12, poludnie = 12, }
local HOUR_PREFIX = { w = true, po = true, przed = true, nad = true, poznym = true } local DAYTIME_SET = { dzien = true, nocy = true, poludniu = true, poludniem = true, poludnie = true, rano = true, ranem = true, wieczorem = true, }
local function parseHourFromCzasLine(lc) local hourWord = lc:match("^jest w przyblizeniu (%a+)") if not hourWord then return nil end local value = HOUR_WORD_VALUE[hourWord] if type(value) ~= "number" then return nil end
local rest = lc:match("^jest w przyblizeniu %a+%s+(.*)$") or "" local firstWord = rest:match("^(%a+)") if firstWord and HOUR_PREFIX[firstWord] then rest = rest:gsub("^%a+%s*", "") end local dtWord = rest:match("^(%a+)") local daytime = (dtWord and DAYTIME_SET[dtWord]) and dtWord or ""
local hours = value if daytime == "poludniu" or daytime == "wieczorem" or (daytime == "nocy" and value >= 6) then hours = hours + 12 end if hours > 23 then hours = 0 end return hours end
local function parseIshtarTimeFromCzasLine(text) local hours = parseHourFromCzasLine(text:lower()) if hours == nil then return nil end local lc = text:lower()
-- "X dzien pory <Sezon>" (numeryczny) local numDay, numSeason = lc:match("(%d%d?)%s*dzien%s+pory%s+(%a+)") if numDay and numSeason then local idx = seasonIndexOf(numSeason) local dayOfMonth = tonumber(numDay) if idx >= 0 and dayOfMonth and dayOfMonth >= 1 and dayOfMonth <= DAYS_PER_SEASON then return { hours = hours, dayOfYear = idx * DAYS_PER_SEASON + dayOfMonth } end end
-- "<slownie> dzien pory <Sezon>" local before, wordSeason = lc:match("(.-)dzien pory%s+(%a+)") if before and wordSeason then local idx = seasonIndexOf(wordSeason) if idx >= 0 then before = trim(before) local dayNum = nil local p1, p2 = before:match("(%a+)[%s%-]+(%a+)$") if p1 and p2 then dayNum = parsePolishOrdinalDay(p1 .. " " .. p2) end if not dayNum then local lastWord = before:match("(%a+)$") if lastWord then dayNum = parsePolishOrdinalDay(lastWord) end end if dayNum and dayNum >= 1 and dayNum <= DAYS_PER_SEASON then return { hours = hours, dayOfYear = idx * DAYS_PER_SEASON + dayNum } end end end
-- Dni specjalne identyfikowane nazwa wydarzenia z HOLIDAYS (dzien empirycznie staly). for _, holiday in ipairs(HOLIDAYS) do local name = holiday.name:lower() if lc:find("%f[%a]" .. name .. "%f[%A]") then return { hours = hours, dayOfYear = holiday.startDayOfYear } end end
return nil end
local function stripAnsi(s) return (s:gsub("\27%[[0-9;%?]*[ -/]*[@-~]", "")) end
local function sanitizeCzasLine(line) local s = stripAnsi(line or "") local bi = s:find("%[") if bi then s = s:sub(1, bi - 1) end s = s:gsub("^%s*>%s*", "") s = s:gsub("%s+", " ") return trim(s) end
local function isLikelyIshtarCzasLine(raw) local lc = raw:lower() if lc:sub(1, 19) ~= "jest w przyblizeniu" then return false end return lc:find("wedlug rachuby czasu starszego ludu", 1, true) ~= nil end
local function isLikelyImperiumCzasLine(raw) local lc = raw:lower() if lc:sub(1, 19) ~= "jest w przyblizeniu" then return false end return lc:find("kalendarza imperialnego", 1, true) ~= nil end
-- ---------- Wyjscie (kolory cecho, znormalizowane wspolnie z imperium) ---------- local C_HEADER = "<yellow>" local C_STAR = "<cyan>" local C_NOW = "<green>" local C_DATA = "<white>" local C_SEP = "<cyan>" local C_RESET = "<reset>"
local function colorForLine(l) if l == "" then return C_RESET end if l:find("TRWA TERAZ", 1, true) or l:find("+++", 1, true) then return C_NOW end if l:find("***", 1, true) then return C_STAR end if l:sub(1, 1) ~= " " and l:sub(-1) == ":" then return C_HEADER end return C_DATA end
local function safeCecho(s) if cecho then cecho(s) else io.write((s:gsub("<%a+>", ""))) end end
local function printFramedReport(lines) safeCecho("\n\n" .. C_SEP .. "---" .. C_RESET .. "\n") for _, l in ipairs(lines) do safeCecho(colorForLine(l) .. l .. C_RESET .. "\n") end safeCecho(C_SEP .. "---" .. C_RESET .. "\n\n") end
local MSG_INTERNAL = { "Blad wewnetrzny kalendarza Ishtar - nie mozna wyliczyc danych." } local MSG_TIMEOUT = { "Brak odpowiedzi na komende 'czas' (timeout) i nie mam zapamietanej daty.", "Sprawdz, czy 'czas' dziala, i sprobuj ponownie.", } -- Zla domena (A3) - komunikat 1:1 z klientem WWW. local MSG_CROSS_DOMAIN = { "Otrzymano czas Imperium - postac jest w domenie Imperium.", "Uzyj /imperium zamiast /ishtar.", }
local MSG_CROSS_NO_ANCHOR = { "Nie mam zapamietanej daty domeny Ishtar - nie moge wyliczyc raportu.", "Bedac w domenie Ishtar, uzyj komendy /ishtar - odczyt zapisze date na przyszlosc.", }
local MSG_RESET_DONE = { "Kotwica Ishtar wyczyszczona. Uzyj /ishtar na zewnatrz, zeby zapisac nowa.", }
local function printUnable() printFramedReport(MSG_INTERNAL) end
local function printTimeout() printFramedReport(MSG_TIMEOUT) end
local function runIshtarReport(now) local ok = pcall(function() printFramedReport(buildResultLines(now)) end) if not ok then printUnable() end end
-- ---------- Stan i kotwica (w pamieci) ---------- local pendingRequest = false local requestStartSec = nil local anchor = nil
-- ---------- Persystencja kotwicy (rekord v2 na dysku profilu) ---------- local ANCHOR_SCHEME = "saovine" local ANCHOR_FILENAME = "ishtar_cal_anchor_v2.lua"
local function anchorFilePath() if not getMudletHomeDir then return nil end return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/" .. ANCHOR_FILENAME end
local function persistAnchorToDisk() if not anchor then return end if not (table.save and table.load) then return end local path = anchorFilePath() if not path then return end pcall(function() table.save(path, { scheme = ANCHOR_SCHEME, dayOfYear = anchor.dayOfYear, hour = anchor.hour, minute = anchor.minute, rlSec = anchor.rlSec, }) end) end
local function isValidAnchorRecord(a) if type(a) ~= "table" then return false end if a.scheme ~= ANCHOR_SCHEME then return false end if type(a.dayOfYear) ~= "number" or a.dayOfYear < 1 or a.dayOfYear > DAYS_PER_YEAR then return false end if type(a.hour) ~= "number" or a.hour < 0 or a.hour > 23 then return false end if type(a.minute) ~= "number" or a.minute < 0 or a.minute > 59 then return false end if type(a.rlSec) ~= "number" or a.rlSec <= 0 then return false end return true end
local function loadPersistedAnchor() if not (table.save and table.load) then return end local path = anchorFilePath() if not path then return end local ok, rec = pcall(table.load, path) if not ok or not isValidAnchorRecord(rec) then return end anchor = { dayOfYear = rec.dayOfYear, hour = rec.hour, minute = rec.minute, rlSec = rec.rlSec, } end
local function clearPending() pendingRequest = false requestStartSec = nil end
local function saveTimeAnchor(dayOfYear, hour, minute) anchor = { dayOfYear = clampInt(dayOfYear, 1, DAYS_PER_YEAR), hour = clampInt(hour, 0, 23), minute = clampInt(minute, 0, 59), rlSec = os.time(), } persistAnchorToDisk() end
local function extrapolateFromAnchor(a, nowSec) local elapsedSec = nowSec - a.rlSec if elapsedSec < 0 then return nil end local elapsedGameMinutes = math.floor(elapsedSec / REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE) local yearTotal = YEAR_TOTAL_GAME_MINUTES local anchorTotal = (a.dayOfYear - 1) * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY + a.hour * 60 + a.minute local nowTotal = ((anchorTotal + elapsedGameMinutes) % yearTotal + yearTotal) % yearTotal local rem = nowTotal % GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY return clampIshtarTime( math.floor(nowTotal / GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY) + 1, math.floor(rem / 60), rem % 60 ) end
local function tryFinishFromAnchor() if not pendingRequest then return false end if not anchor then return false end local now = extrapolateFromAnchor(anchor, os.time()) if not now or not isValidIshtarTime(now.dayOfYear, now.hours, now.minutes) then return false end clearPending() printFramedReport({ "Pokazuje Ishtar wyliczone z zapisanej daty (ostatni odczyt: " .. os.date("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M", anchor.rlSec) .. ").", }) runIshtarReport(now) return true end
-- ---------- Handlery (wywolywane przez trigger / alias z XML) ---------- function ishtar_cal.onCzasLine(lineText) local raw = sanitizeCzasLine(lineText) if not isLikelyIshtarCzasLine(raw) then return end
local parsed = parseIshtarTimeFromCzasLine(raw) if not parsed or not isValidIshtarTime(parsed.dayOfYear, parsed.hours, 0) then return end
-- O1: kotwica z KAZDEJ poprawnie sparsowanej linii wlasnej domeny, -- takze bez pending (np. linia z /pasek, reczne 'czas', cudzy skrypt). saveTimeAnchor(parsed.dayOfYear, parsed.hours, 0)
if not pendingRequest then return end -- Okno stale (paritet z www/dargoth): spozniona linia przy wiszacym -- pending nie dostaje gagu ani raportu; kotwica juz zapisana wyzej. if requestStartSec and os.time() - requestStartSec > REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.2 then return end
if deleteLine then deleteLine() end
clearPending() runIshtarReport({ dayOfYear = parsed.dayOfYear, hours = parsed.hours, minutes = 0 }) end
-- Zla domena (A3, jak w kliencie WWW): tylko przy wlasnym pending - -- komunikat, gag linii, kasowanie pending (bez timeoutu); potem raport -- zadanej domeny z jej zapisanej daty (wariant A) lub komunikat S6. function ishtar_cal.onCrossLine(lineText) if not pendingRequest then return end if requestStartSec and os.time() - requestStartSec > REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.2 then return end local raw = sanitizeCzasLine(lineText) if not isLikelyImperiumCzasLine(raw) then return end
if deleteLine then deleteLine() end
clearPending() printFramedReport(MSG_CROSS_DOMAIN)
-- Wariant A: raport zadanej domeny z jej wlasnej zapisanej daty (bez delt -- miedzy domenami). Brak zapisanej daty -> komunikat S6. local now = anchor and extrapolateFromAnchor(anchor, os.time()) or nil if now and isValidIshtarTime(now.dayOfYear, now.hours, now.minutes) then printFramedReport({ "Pokazuje Ishtar wyliczone z zapisanej daty (ostatni odczyt: " .. os.date("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M", anchor.rlSec) .. ").", }) runIshtarReport(now) else printFramedReport(MSG_CROSS_NO_ANCHOR) end end
function ishtar_cal.onAlias() if pendingRequest then return end pendingRequest = true requestStartSec = os.time() if send then send("czas", false) end
if tempTimer then tempTimer(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.05, function() if not pendingRequest then return end if tryFinishFromAnchor() then return end clearPending() printTimeout() end) end end
-- /ishtar reset (G2): czysci WYLACZNIE kotwice wlasnej domeny (RAM + plik), -- nie rusza cache'u updatera ani niczego innego. Idempotentny. Kotwica -- nie wygasa - reset to swiadome czyszczenie na zadanie gracza. function ishtar_cal.onReset() anchor = nil local path = anchorFilePath() if path and os.remove then os.remove(path) end printFramedReport(MSG_RESET_DONE) end

-- ==================================================== autoaktualizacja -- Repo publiczne na GitHub: releases/latest (anonimowe API) -> asset -- .mpackage -> uninstallPackage -> installPackage (wzorzec skryptow -- aktualizacji Tjurczyka). Check przy starcie z throttlem 8 h (cache na -- dysku profilu); miedzy checkami powiadomienie odtwarzane z knownLatest. -- Komenda /ishtar aktualizuj pomija throttle. -- Stala tozsamosc paczki (F1/F2): download do <pkg>.mpackage i sweep -- legacy nazw przed instalacja (mudlet-web nazywa paczke od pliku). local UPDATE_REPO = "arkadia-mudlet-calendar_ishtar" local UPDATE_PKG_NAME = "ishtar_cal" local UPDATE_CMD = "/ishtar aktualizuj" local UPDATE_THROTTLE_SEC = 8 * 3600 local UPDATE_API_URL = "https://api.github.com/repos/Isithunzi000/" .. UPDATE_REPO .. "/releases/latest" local UPDATE_CACHE_PATH = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/ishtar_cal_update_cache.lua" -- Historyczne nazwy paczek na mudlet-web (tozsamosc = nazwa pliku): -- wersjonowane assety release + dawniej <pkg>_update. Komplet wg -- Releases API + wersje z dzur (13-15m); self = kamizelka na lokalne buildy. local UPDATE_LEGACY_PKGS = { "ishtar_cal_update", "ishtar_cal_1_8_11m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_12m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_13m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_14m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_15m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_16m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_17m", "ishtar_cal_1_8_18m", "ishtar_cal_" .. PLUGIN_VERSION:gsub("%.", "_"), }
local updateDlHandlers = {} local updateMetaPath = nil local updatePkgPath = nil local updatePendingVersion = nil local updateManual = false
local function updateCacheRead() local t = {} local ok, res = pcall(table.load, UPDATE_CACHE_PATH, t) if ok and res then return t end return {} end
local function updateCacheWrite(latest) pcall(table.save, UPDATE_CACHE_PATH, { lastCheck = os.time(), knownLatest = latest }) end
local function updateVersionParts(v) local parts = {} for seg in tostring(v):gmatch("[^%.]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = tonumber(seg:match("^%d+")) or 0 end return parts end
-- Porownanie numeryczne segmentow (suffix literowy pomijany): 1.8.9m < 1.8.16m. local function updateVersionNewer(a, b) local pa, pb = updateVersionParts(a), updateVersionParts(b) for i = 1, math.max(#pa, #pb) do local x, y = pa[i] or 0, pb[i] or 0 if x ~= y then return x > y end end return false end
local function updateSay(msg) safeCecho(C_HEADER .. "[ishtar_cal] " .. msg .. C_RESET .. "\n") end
local function updateNotify(latest) safeCecho("\n" .. C_HEADER .. "[ishtar_cal] Dostepna nowa wersja " .. latest .. " (masz " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. "). Wpisz " .. C_NOW .. UPDATE_CMD .. C_RESET .. C_HEADER .. " aby zaktualizowac." .. C_RESET .. "\n\n") end
local function updateFail(what) updateSay("Nie udalo sie " .. what .. " - sprobuj pozniej.") end
local function updateKillHandlers() for k, id in pairs(updateDlHandlers) do killAnonymousEventHandler(id) updateDlHandlers[k] = nil end end
local function updateOnError(event) updateKillHandlers() updateMetaPath = nil updatePkgPath = nil updatePendingVersion = nil updateFail("sprawdzic aktualizacji") end
local function updateOnPkgDone(event, path) if path ~= updatePkgPath then return end updateKillHandlers() local v = updatePendingVersion updatePkgPath = nil updatePendingVersion = nil pcall(uninstallPackage, UPDATE_PKG_NAME) for _, legacyName in ipairs(UPDATE_LEGACY_PKGS) do pcall(uninstallPackage, legacyName) end tempTimer(1, function() installPackage(path) os.remove(path) updateSay("Zaktualizowano do wersji " .. v .. ". Zrestartuj Mudleta, aby zmiany zadzialaly.") end) end
local function updateOnMetaDone(event, path) if path ~= updateMetaPath then return end updateMetaPath = nil if updateDlHandlers.meta then killAnonymousEventHandler(updateDlHandlers.meta) updateDlHandlers.meta = nil end local ok, meta = pcall(function() local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then error("brak pliku metadanych") end local body = f:read("*a") f:close() return yajl.to_value(body) end) if not ok or type(meta) ~= "table" or type(meta.tag_name) ~= "string" then updateKillHandlers() updateFail("sprawdzic aktualizacji") return end local latest = meta.tag_name:gsub("^v", "") updateCacheWrite(latest) if not updateVersionNewer(latest, PLUGIN_VERSION) then updateKillHandlers() if updateManual then updateSay("Masz najnowsza wersje (" .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ").") end return end if not updateManual then updateKillHandlers() updateNotify(latest) return end local url = nil if type(meta.assets) == "table" then for _, a in ipairs(meta.assets) do if type(a) == "table" and type(a.browser_download_url) == "string" and a.browser_download_url:match("%.mpackage$") then url = a.browser_download_url break end end end if not url then url = "https://github.com/Isithunzi000/" .. UPDATE_REPO .. "/releases/download/v" .. latest .. "/" .. UPDATE_PKG_NAME .. ".mpackage" end updatePendingVersion = latest updatePkgPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/" .. UPDATE_PKG_NAME .. ".mpackage" updateDlHandlers.pkg = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", updateOnPkgDone) downloadFile(updatePkgPath, url) end
local function startUpdateCheck(manual) updateManual = manual and true or false if mudletOlderThan and mudletOlderThan(4, 6) then if updateManual then updateSay("Aktualizator wymaga Mudleta 4.6 lub nowszego.") end return end if not updateManual then local cache = updateCacheRead() local lastCheck = tonumber(cache.lastCheck) or 0 if os.time() - lastCheck < UPDATE_THROTTLE_SEC then if type(cache.knownLatest) == "string" and updateVersionNewer(cache.knownLatest, PLUGIN_VERSION) then updateNotify(cache.knownLatest) end return end end updateMetaPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/" .. UPDATE_PKG_NAME .. "_update_meta.json" updateDlHandlers.meta = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", updateOnMetaDone) updateDlHandlers.err = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", updateOnError) downloadFile(updateMetaPath, UPDATE_API_URL) end
function ishtar_cal.onAktualizuj() startUpdateCheck(true) end
function ishtar_cal_init(event, arg) if event == "sysInstallPackage" and arg ~= "ishtar_cal" then return end loadPersistedAnchor() tempTimer(10, function() startUpdateCheck(false) end) if cecho then cecho("<green>[ishtar_cal]<reset> Kalendarz Ishtar v" .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. " zaladowany. Wpisz <yellow>/ishtar<reset> (pomoc: <yellow>/ishtar help<reset>).\n") end end
